description: Rows that open their content below, one at a time or several (DESIGN.md, Accordion): each header is a button in a heading, with a chevron that turns 180° while open; the content's height animates over TsuyaDuration.base (instant under reduced motion). multiple false (the default) keeps at most one value open at a time: opening a row closes the one already open.

constructors.description: An accordion over items, the rows named in value open.

params.name: multiple
params.description: Lets several rows stay open together; otherwise opening one closes the others.

params.name: onChanged
params.description: Called with the next list of open values when a row is toggled.

params.name: headingLevel
params.description: The level of the heading each header sits in.
